title: Fluid Dynamics and Nonlinear Systems
content: Fluid dynamics and nonlinear systems govern the continuous flow of matter and the chaotic behavior of dynamical systems. Navigating the Navier-Stokes equations, boundary layer theory, and the transition to turbulence, this roadmap explores the deterministic chaos, bifurcations, and astrophysical fluid instabilities of classical and relativistic media.
